title: I Love to Tell the Story
lyrics: I [G]love to tell the story of [C]unseen things a - [G]bove,
Of [D]Jesus and [G]His glory of Jesus and his [D7]love
I love to tell the sto - [G]ry be-[Em]cause I know 'tis [B7]true;
It [C]satisfies my long-[G]ings as [D7]nothing else can [G]do.
I [D]love to tell the sto - [G]ry, 'twill [C]be my theme in glo - [G]ry
To tell the old, old [Am]sto - [C]ry of [G]Jesus [D7]and his [G]love.
I [G]love to tell the story; more [C]wonderful it [G]seems
than [D]all the gold - [G]en fancies of all our golden [D7]dreams.
I love to tell the sto - [G]ry, it [Em]did so much for [B7]me;
and [C]that is just the rea - [G]son I [D7]tell it now to [G]thee.
I [G]love to tell the story; 'tis [C]pleasant to re - [G]peat
What [D]seems each time [G]I tell it more won-der-ful-ly [D7]sweet
I love to tell the sto - [G]ry for [Em]some have never [B7]heard
The [C]message of salva - [G]tion from [D7]God's own holy [G]word
I [G]love to tell the story, for [C]those who know it [G]best
Seem [D]hungering [G]and thirsting to hear it like the [D7]rest.
And when in scenes of glo - [G]ry I [Em]sing the new, new [B7]song
'twill [C]be the old, old sto - [G]ry that [D7]I have loved so [G]long.
